kill_switch_act_119.text:
With the growing number of incidents involving rogue AI agents, Congress must pass commonsense safeguards to protect the public. 

Last week, I officially became a cosponsor of the bipartisan AI Kill Switch Act, a bill to establish third-party protections against rogue AI agents. We need safeguards that ensure AI remains under human control.

deepseek.reason: The speaker self-identifies as a cosponsor of the AI Kill Switch Act and calls for safeguards ensuring AI remains under human control.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names the bill and identifies the speaker as a cosponsor.

kill_switch_act_119.text: It's beyond irresponsible that Speaker Johnson is choosing to shut down the House of Representatives while AI executives are sending urgent warnings on the need for AI safeguards. Congress would not be starting from scratch on this issue. There are commonsense, bipartisan AI safeguard bills ready to be voted on. For example, I strongly support the AI Kill Switch Act to put emergency third-party protections in place to protect against the threat of rogue AI programs acting outside of human control.

deepseek.reason: The speaker explicitly says he strongly supports the AI Kill Switch Act and describes its emergency protections.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement names the AI Kill Switch Act and directly endorses it.
